_comment: Click-band alias-audit baseline. REFRESHED 2026-09-23 (second refresh that day) for two changes: (1) the Reed Bar Trim default moved 12.5K -> 17.2K (drive at the canonical vol 0.5 stimulus -1.3 dB), and (2) speaker character 0 became a true passthrough (the 20 Hz / 20 kHz 'bypass' biquads no longer run). Attribution measured: re-running note 84 at vol 0.59, which restores the old drive, gives step_up 6.3 vs 5.4 before, i.e. ~0.9 dB from the filter removal; the remaining ~1.7 dB at vol 0.5 is the drive (crossover residual proportionally larger at lower drive). hf_band_dbc is unchanged within 0.05 dB on every note, so no fold-back signature; the note-84 move is a notch at H9 shifting (-2.5 dB), the harmonic the plateau metric keys on. Earlier refreshes: 2026-09-23 (drawn volume network), 2026-09-13 (pickup corner 2312 -> 880 Hz), v0.5.1 capture. Generated by `preamp-bench alias-audit --note <n> --velocity 120 --json` at 44.1 kHz.
